why: The green direction of the corpus runner itself. A correct application, a frozen contract that describes it accurately and a precompiled plan that probes it faithfully must produce PASS and exit 0 — through a service on an ephemeral loopback port, a Deterministic Gate, an http probe and a shell probe, so the runner is proven against the stages a defect-class fixture will use rather than against a trivial one. It embodies no defect class from brief section 7; the numbered classes belong to stories 6.2 (1, 2, 3, 5, 10), 6.3 (6, 7, 8, 9, 11) and 6.4.
